title: U.S. Strike on Iranian School May Have Been War Crime, U.N. Report Says
summary_full: Mistakes that led to the deaths of more than a hundred children “went beyond negligence,” investigators said. They also cited a separate strike the same day that killed a reported 22 civilians.
